200.description: The scan is accepted (or, on a retry with a repeated `Idempotency-Key` and identical body, the original answer replayed without counting the scan again).

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing (`idempotency-key-required`), or the request body is malformed JSON, a required field is missing or empty, or a field value is invalid (`invalid-request`).

409.description: The scan does not fit the task or its claim: the task has no active claim or another station owns it, `unknown-gtin` (no pack level carries the code), `invalid-scanned-gtin` (a bad check digit or a variable-measure indicator), `scan-sku-mismatch` (the GTIN of another SKU, for example the each barcode printed on a case of something else), `scan-level-mismatch` (a case scan on an each pick or the reverse), `no-pick-plan` or `pick-over-quantity`.
